news.title: ISRO Releases Scientific Data Archive from Chandrayaan Mission on ISSDC
news.text: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has officially opened the scientific payload repository on the Indian Space Science Data Centre for researchers globally.
news.author: Dr. S. Nair

news.title: India Meteorological Department Issues Heatwave Alert for Northern States
news.text: IMD red alert advisory issued for Delhi, Rajasthan, and Haryana with temperatures touching 45C. Public advised to stay hydrated.
news.author: Bureau Reporter

news.title: State Road Transport Authority Reviews Potential 10% Fare Revision Next Quarter
news.text: Regional transport unions submit memorandum proposing tariff updates to offset diesel expenses. Ministry committee review planned.
news.author: A. Verma
